text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen has come at last, bringing with it a number of formidable senior participants.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Of those seniors, the racers garnering the most attention are T.M Opera O—otherwise known as the Centurial Overlord—and her rival, Meisho Doto.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Manhattan Cafe's focus lies elsewhere.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Believing her friend is truly in reach, Manhattan Cafe heads for the track. This could be the end of a pursuit that started when she was a child.
